instruction.text: You are talking to a historian about the Titanic. Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: Has the wreckage of the Titanic been ((++found painted))?
atoms.sound: ssml:<prosody pitch = '-0.5st'> Has the wreckage of the Titanic been found?</prosody>

atoms.b: Yes! It was found in 1985, 73 years after it ((++sank flew)).
Why did it take so ((++long many_sweets)) to find?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-0.5st'>Why did it take so long to find?</prosody>

atoms.b: Before then, they didn’t have the equipment to go so far down into the ((++ocean desert)).

feedback.finish: After finding the wreckage, many items from the ship have been recovered and sold for lots of money.

instruction.text: Select the expensive items that have been recovered from the Titanic.

trainers.hint: More than one answer can be correct.

feedback.finish: In total, nearly 6,000 items have been recovered from the Titanic. These include statues, jewellery, furniture and plates.

instruction.text: How do you think the memory of the Titanic has been kept alive? Select all correct answers.

trainers.hint: More than one answer can be correct.

atoms.b: There are many museums across the ((++world ocean)) that remember the Titanic. The most ((++popular ugly)) ones can be found in Southampton and Belfast.
There are also many different ((++books water_bottles)) and ((++films sticky_notes)). They help to keep the memory of the Titanic alive.
